text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: This looks like... the Umalator, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Correct!
We would like Gentildonna to undergo
a series of tests within a VR space.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Our Satono Group has utilized vast amounts of data gathered from Umamusume to develop training support tools.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna-san's extraordinary power
is legendary even within the academy!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: As the Satono Group, we would love to measure that power and use the data to improve our tools!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Our goal is to complete the ultimate training support tool for all Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure this will pay off in a great way
for Gentildonna-san as well."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, that is... quite intriguing.
In virtual space, moving around a bit flashily shouldn't be an issue, after all.
choice_data_list: (The leg press broke the other day too...)
(The leg press broke the other day too, after all...)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I will gladly cooperate with the measurements.
Please, give me your instructions.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your
cooperation!
Shall we get started, then?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Operation check complete! All clear!
Gentildonna-san, please kick the sandbag in front of you with all your might."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Whooooaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! The sandbag
flew right off...!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
She flew straight through the air and shattered the window pane?!
M-Measurement error... Let's just move on to the next one, the next one!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting!
Next, we'll measure your punch strength.
Do you see the panel hanging on the wall?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. So I just have to punch this, correct?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
D-Did I just hear a creak!?
Oh no...! There's a crack in the wall!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, it-it's collapsing!!
Stop, stooooop!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I... It's way too off the charts.
The system almost went haywire...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it's immeasurable...
Is that all, then?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"No, far from it!
The Satono Group's system
won't end here!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I left it on the default settings to get a rough baseline.
I'll adjust the parameters and fine-tune the measurement range!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this, I'll measure it no matter what!
Dia, are you ready!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The power worthy of the title 'Steely Grand Dame'...
I'm endlessly fascinated by it, too...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I-I got the data...! I finally did it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What phenomenal numbers...!
They've vastly exceeded the dev team's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'll need to consult with the researchers on how to apply
these results, but I'm sure they'll find a way to make the most of it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much,
Gentildonna-san!
We'll put this valuable data to good use!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu...
choice_data_list: You're in a good mood, huh.
You seem to be in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. I thought they were truly admirable people.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To see them strive so eagerly
to improve our training environment
is truly a delightful thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The reason is, of course, so she can focus on training without worrying about the machine's durability. But that's not all.
choice_data_list: Because it ties into training other Umamusume too?
Because precise measurements can show off your power?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna was unusually eager to collect data.
She was undoubtedly thinking about the Umamusume
she would be competing against in the future.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If my data is necessary for them to become strong,
I will gladly provide it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"To crush beneath my heel those who have thoroughly studied me, used my strength as fuel, and reached their absolute peak.
...How delightful that must feel."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fighting spirit and burning hunger seeping through her matter-of-fact tone.
Only someone who truly, wholeheartedly believed she was the strongest could say such words—and it brought a spontaneous smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna was unusually eager to collect data.
She was undoubtedly thinking about the Umamusume
who look up to her.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. Numbers are absolute, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Faced with a scientifically proven, overwhelming disparity,
everyone falls into despair.
Yet if someone still manages to rally their spirits... *chuckle*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She cut her words short and wore a fearless smile.
The dense aura of an absolute powerhouse oozing from her
sent shivers down my spine.
